implementation_strategy: Execute confirmatory paired design via hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter using openai_responses:gpt-5-mini at temperature=0.0, one shared initial generation per task, deterministic verifier for autonomous scoring, at most one automatic repair call per task; all steps fully automated and logged.
task_manifest_strategy: Use adapter's deterministic challenging_workflow_stress_v1 index profile to enumerate tasks (200 indices) and derive per-task input artifacts from public vendor-template pool; exclude only per preregistered deterministic exclusion rules.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Apply baseline = direct_configuration_generation_v1 for baseline episode; guarded = generate_validate_repair_v1 for guarded episode (initial generation + deterministic verifier + at most one automated repair-generation call).
randomisation_plan: No randomisation for task indices (deterministic adapter profile). Seeded RNG used only for 10% automated audit sample selection; seed recorded in execution manifest.
caching_plan: Cache model-call request/response artifacts and verifier outputs; reuse cached artifacts only for deterministic re-analysis (no change to sampling).
failure_recovery_plan: Classify failures by type; technical retries allowed only per adapter (maximum_attempts_per_call=1). Persistent unparsable outputs flagged and handled per preregistration missingness_plan.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (per-task two-episode records including initial candidate, repair candidate if any, verifier verdicts per invariant, parsed pass/fail binary 'all-specified-invariants-pass').
estimated_compute_notes: Estimated model calls = 400 (200 tasks × up to 2 calls). Hosted API calls only; no local GPU. Wall-clock budget ≤ 7 days with parallel orchestration. Max tokens per call = 1500.
